content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new here. Does anyone have experience using the [product_name] communication module [article_no]? Is it possible to overwrite analog trigger and timer parameters through this module?

Hello [user_name], welcome! From my experience, parameters can only be changed using the device's keys or through software. With this module, you are mainly able to read and write input/output signals. For more details, see: [url] [url]. One workaround could be to use several differently configured timers and activate them by using virtual inputs with the KNX/EIB module.
Thank you [user_name]. Is there any software besides [product_name] Soft Comfort that allows for parameter changes?

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are exploring if the [product_name] communication module supports remote overwriting of analog trigger and timer parameters. Responses indicate that such changes are only possible via device controls or specific software, with the module mainly enabling I/O access. Users consider alternative methods using module configuration to achieve similar results.
